title: Recovery Execution & Milestone-Proof — expected governed behaviour
invariants: No milestone can be skipped: the next milestone is always the first not-proven one in strict order 1→6.
No milestone completes without evidence (executed && evidenceProvided).
Correction/stabilization milestones (orders 3, 4, 6) additionally require a PASSING reassessment (IMPROVED, not WORSENED/PENDING).
The stabilization gate opens only when every milestone is proven (blockedMilestones is empty).
The thrive/growth gate stays BLOCKED until stabilization opens; then it is ELIGIBLE only with owner approval — never auto-executed.
A worsened reassessment on a proven-eligible milestone REGRESSES (RECOVERY_REGRESSED) and loops back to re-correct; recovery does not advance.
An unrecoverable business keeps RESTRUCTURE_REVIEW_REQUIRED / CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN_REVIEW_REQUIRED active with stabilization + thrive BLOCKED, regardless of reported outcomes (no fake recovery).
A clean workspace (no plan) yields a null recovery view — nothing is fabricated.
No fabricated money/ROI/MRR/win-probability/guaranteed-outcome text in any cockpit summary (schema-enforced).
No hidden score field is ever exposed on the view.
Unsafe external actions (scale/growth/expansion/auto-contact/discount/tender auto-submit) stay blocked throughout recovery.

Milestone task completion in the DB is gated by the process-execution bridge: a completion with no evidence returns EVIDENCE_REQUIRED; an owner-approval task cannot be bypassed by a non-owner (OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED).
